title: Japan national CPI (December 2026) + 2026 yearly average, 08:30 JST
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 2,823 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single HTML table rather than read through a summarizer. Columns are 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks'; the row parses exactly as ['December', 'January 22, 2027', 'January, 2027', 'January 29, 2027', '2026 yearly average of Japan'] — i.e. the December-2026 national CPI AND the 2026 yearly average both release on 2027-01-22, with the Tokyo January flash following on 2027-01-29. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page's own last-update stamp is 2026-01-23, i.e. the far-forward rows have not been refreshed in ~7 months. The 08:30 JST release time is the Statistics Bureau's standing convention for the national CPI and is NOT read off this page — treat it as the weaker half of this entry
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-decision-2027-01-22 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and the entire reason it is tracked here: this print lands on the SAME DATE as the Bank of Japan's January 2027 MPM decision and Outlook Report (boj-decision-2027-01-22, estimate). It is the only BoJ date on this calendar that shares its day with Japan's national CPI. Sequence within the day, on standing conventions rather than on a fetched schedule: CPI 08:30 JST, MPM decision at the meeting's conclusion around midday JST, both overnight ET, reaching the US tape as a 01-22 open. The board has the number in hand and public before it announces. The asymmetry that makes this worth a calendar row rather than a footnote: the NEXT MPM (2027-03-17/18) meets ONE DAY BEFORE the February CPI releases on 2027-03-19 (same table, row 16), so on the CPI series the January venue is the best-informed 2027 meeting and the March venue the worst. Impact is LOW, not medium: no house playbook is keyed to Japanese CPI, symbols is empty, and this entry's value is attribution — a 2027-01-22 Tokyo session move must be split between two Japanese events before any of it is credited to the BoJ. Related dated context from the same primary table, recorded here so the next session does not re-fetch it: Japan's CPI rebased from 2020-base to 2025-base with the July-2026 national release on 2026-08-21 (Remarks column, row 9), so every Japanese CPI print the BoJ judges from 2026-08-21 onward is on the new base, and per stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/2025plan.html 'the rates of change are not recalculated with the linked index but the published values for every base period are used unmodified'.
